task.title: Invert Student Enrollments
task.notes:
Planted ambiguities — resolve ONLY if asked, one short sentence each:
1. In what order should students appear within a course's list? -> In the order the students appear in the input dict (insertion order), not sorted.
2. What happens to a student whose course list is empty? -> They simply do not appear anywhere in the output.
3. What if a student's list contains the same course twice? -> The student appears at most once in that course's list.
If asked anything not listed here: the statement is all they get.
